statement: On a single-device btrfs host, decide capacity knowing metadata uses the DUP profile by default: DUP keeps two copies on one device and reports 50 percent space utilization, so metadata occupies twice its logical size in raw space.

On a single-device btrfs filesystem the metadata profile defaults to DUP, so a host with one device should expect duplicated metadata block groups unless mkfs time or a later balance changed the profile.
quote: Default on a single device filesystem is *DUP* and is recommended for metadata

statement: Since btrfs-progs 5.15 mkfs.btrfs always chooses DUP for metadata on a single device regardless of the rotational flag, so the pre-5.15 automatic single profile for SSDs no longer applies.
quote: changed in version 5.15 to be always *dup*.

statement: DUP is not restricted to one device: mkfs.btrfs since 4.5.1 allows creating DUP on multiple devices, and a DUP block group started on a single device may later exist on more devices.
quote: another one is added. Since version 4.5.1, :command:`mkfs.btrfs` will let you create DUP
